about: the suite examples: one job each, one file each at examples/<job>/<id>/example.ts. the suite shows the file as its source; the library repos copy the same files into their examples folders. layout is the hackbuild-ui layout the example draws; model is the ai-views job its model chip picks for, when it has one.
